title: Rectangular Cat Scratcher Board with Felt Pads, 80 x 25 cm
bullets: 80 x 25 cm board gives your cat a clear surface to scratch
Felt pads included with the board
Made for indoor pets as a claw sharpening board
One-piece board keeps setup to a single item
A simple way to offer a scratching spot away from the sofa
description: Cats like to scratch, and a board gives them a place to do it instead of the furniture. This rectangular scratcher measures 80 x 25 cm. It is made for indoor pets and works as a claw sharpening board. The board is made of felt and includes felt pads. It arrives as a single piece, so there is one item to set up. Measure your space before you order, since the board is 80 x 25 cm. Pick a spot where your cat already likes to scratch, and set the board there. Give your cat a place to scratch that is not the sofa, and see whether they take to it. If you are a cat parent who wants a simple option for indoor scratching, this board is worth a look. Each board ships in a plastic bag. Check the shipping estimate before you order.
